header: New Minecraft Dungeons II capes are coming!
body:
The Nacreous and Snow Golem Capes have been revealed for Minecraft Dungeons II! These capes are expected to release on December 1st, 2026 in the upcoming The Humblers Awaken DLC.

Both of these capes are now available to use in Bedrock Cosmos as well!
